purpose: Detect endpoints that return verbose error pages leaking stack traces, framework error classes, or internal file paths.
when_to_use: Safe-active check (risk 2) on an authorized web application once passive checks are done. Requires an authorization that permits safe-validation. Probe paths are read-only GETs that should not change state.
detection_approach: Send read-only GETs to a configured set of probe paths likely to trigger errors, then scan the response body for error-page signatures (stack frames like 'at file:line', framework error classes such as SequelizeDatabaseError/UnauthorizedError, language tracebacks). Report any endpoint whose response matches.

references.title: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
